name: yandex_device_action
description: Control a device of the Yandex Smart Home. Use the device id, capability and instance exactly as shown in <yandex_home>. Examples: on_off/on = true; range/brightness = 40; color_setting/temperature_k = 2700; range/temperature = 22; mode/thermostat = "heat".

capability.description: on_off, range, color_setting, mode or toggle

instance.description: e.g. on, brightness, temperature_k, hsv, volume, channel

value.description: true/false, a number, a mode name, or {"h":..,"s":..,"v":..} for hsv

name: yandex_scenario
description: Run a scenario of the Yandex Smart Home by its id from <yandex_home>.
